services.desc: At Sky’s The Limit we are proud of our fleet of state of the art, impeccably maintained European style balloons. Each one is inspected daily by our pilots and crew and every 100 hours of flying by a FAA certified inspection facility to make sure that the balloons are always in prime condition. blurb: Guests take hot air balloon rides lasting about an hour, covering approximately six miles depending on wind conditions. The entire experience takes about four hours from meeting to return. Flights operate year-round, typically in early mornings or late afternoons for stable air conditions.

quotes.text: Last night I took my 92 year old dad on a hot air balloon ride with Sky’s The Limit Ballooning Adventures and I can’t begin to tell you how impressed I (we) were about the whole experience from check in to drop off. The crew and pilot could not have been nicer or more accommodating helping him get in and out of the basket. The flight was so smooth, the scenery absolutely beautiful!! We were also very impressed by the smooth landing!! After we got home my dad said he wanted to do it again! Thanks about an awesome evening!!

My girlfriend wanted “romantic” and I wanted “fun” so we went on a hot air balloon ride. What a hoot. We went on a warm sunny day and it was beautiful. There was some white noise but it was hugely better than those views from a helicopter or airplane and lasted a lot longer than hang gliding. The whole ride was very relaxing and we had the time to talk and appreciate the county in a way we never had before. Everyone was fantastic. I want to go again.

We just finished a sunrise ride over Temecula, and it was beautiful. Our pilot, Jeff, was wonderful and very experienced. The ride lasted just over an hour and we finished with muffins and mimosas and a little history of ballooning. Great views of mountains, vineyards and sunrise. The ride was relaxing and peaceful, reaching max height of 5200 feet. I would definitely recommend Sky’s the Limit Adventure and will come back to them again

Most fun you can have legally. You get so high and see so much. I’ve lived in the north county coastal for almost 30 years and have never seen the places I’ve seen today. Going over Rancho Santa Fe was magnificient. These guys are pros and the way they pilot, yes pilot, the balloon is something to behold. Do yourself a favor and mark off that bucket list line and ride this hot air balloon!

The flight was so smooth, the scenery absolutely beautiful!! We were also very impressed by the smooth landing!! After we got home my dad said he wanted to do it again! Thanks about an awesome evening!!
This was my first experience and I cannot wait to do it again. The guys were friendly and informative and safe. If you are thinking about booking, do not hesitate!!!
